description: Defines the VideoDecoder class interface for decoding encoded video streams into video frames, including methods for initialization, input handling, and retrieving decode targets.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Interface for decoding encoded video streams into video frames, managing input buffers, and providing decode targets.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the decoder with callback functions for status updates and error handling.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of frames the renderer should cache before preroll is complete.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout in microseconds for considering preroll complete.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the soft limit of maximum cached frames.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds encoded video frames into the decoder for decoding.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals that no more input data will be provided.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears cached buffers.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target (texture) for rendering.
